deadline_equals_block_timestamp.meaning: the deadline argument passed to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager equals the mining-time block.timestamp

deadline_bounds_mining_time.meaning: the supplied deadline bounds when the transaction may be mined (deadline is a proper future bound, not equal to block.timestamp)

executed_at_later_time.meaning: the pending transaction is executed at a later time than originally intended

assumptions: The deadline argument is observable as equal to block.timestamp at call time.
A proper deadline is a value that bounds the mining time rather than equaling block.timestamp.

unresolved.description: The report does not give a concrete numeric deadline bound or the exact later execution time; the relation is represented qualitatively.

limitations: The report states a capability for delayed execution, not a concrete exploited transaction sequence.
The relation is formalized qualitatively because no numeric deadline or delay duration is supplied.
